notes.title: Area Zero v1.2.0
notes.content: [h1]1.2.0 (09/02/2025)[/h1][olist][*][p]Prevents crash on more recent Vulkan drivers, which may have extensive lists of device extensions.[/p][/*][*][p]Characters will always face the direction of the attack source on block.[/p][/*][*][p]Reverts cross up attack attribute added in v1.1.1.[/p][/*][*][p]Reassigns Niven's back and down supers.[/p][p]a. "Fool Compliance" and "Allowable Opinion" are now activated with back and down, respectively.[/p][p]b. Updates Niven's combo trials and CPU behavior accordingly.[/p][/*][*][p]Characters hit with one of Christopher's balloon bombs will always respond by facing toward the bomb.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Area Zero v1.1.1
notes.content: [h1]1.1.1 (08/27/2025)[/h1][olist][*][p]  Reduces time for initialization by removing redundant file reads and shader compiles.[/p][/*][*][p]  Reduces time used for swap chain recreation (resizing window, tabbing in/out of window, etc.).[/p][/*][*][p]  Updates versus loading screen with new layout and assets.[/p][/*][*][p]  Adds "cross up" attack attribute. [/p][p]a. Only attacks with this attribute will be able to cross up the opponent.[/p][/*][*][p]  Adds custom meter colors to B.P.V. and Niven during install supers.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Area Zero v1.1.0
notes.content: [h1]1.1.0 (08/19/2025)[/h1][olist][*][p]New super attacks for each character.[/p][p]a. Similar to specials, super attacks are now activated by holding a direction and pressing the super (Su) button.[/p][p]b. Each character now has a super corresponding to holding left, right or down on the controller.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated tutorials to include new super activation inputs.[/p][/*][*][p]Combo trials updated to demonstrate usage of new super attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Move lists updated with new supers and taunt bonus changes.[/p][/*][*][p]Guard meter capacity reduced for all characters.[/p][/*][*][p]New color palettes added for each character.[/p][/*][*][p]Match timer extended to 300 seconds.[/p][p]a. This could be considered similar to five 60-second rounds in a best of five scenario.[/p][/*][*][p]Preprocessed animation frames to help reduce GPU memory usage.[/p][/*][*][p]Iterated on computer-controlled opponent behavior.[/p][p]a. Novice difficulty less likely to retreat when at a life deficit.[/p][p]b. Evades and side switch become more likely as difficulty increases.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced size of secondary stage assets (depth, global lighting) to reduce GPU memory usage.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved transition from run into super and special attacks.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p]

notes.content:

notes.title: Update notes for Area Zero v1.01
notes.content:
[h1]1.0.1 (07/20/2025)[/h1]

[olist]
1. Prevents an infinite combo for Violet and updates her advanced combo trials to accommodate the changes.
2. Prevents potential for a crash when the combo counter exceeds 99 hits or 9,999 damage.
[/olist]
